# Under --wire-typelate-sse the callback options element type must be the
# wired library's MessageOption.

! muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server --wire-typelate-sse
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

-- want-err.txt --
Error: the sseNum callback options must be ...sse.MessageOption from github.com/typelate/sse, got server.Option
-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET /numbers sse(Numbers(ctx, sseNum))"}}{{end}}
{{define "sseNum"}}{{.Result}}{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Option func()

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Numbers(_ context.Context, sseNum func(int, ...Option) error) error {
	return sseNum(7)
}
